courses: Seeds 20260953 and 20260954, even lanes 0 through 14; 16 independent one-G1/one-ball courses
common_setup: Frozen SONIC and late-swing actor, same runner/asset/parent/course, revalidate side, lateral cap 0.15 m, forward cap 0.08 m, 300 frames, independent simulator process per arm
required_audits: Report/trace hashes, independent physical contact, per-frame task-space action replay, frame-30 precontact feature equality, and paired source/asset/actor/parent hashes
measure: Foot-only first contact, 60-frame forward/lateral displacement, maximum lateral excursion, minimum pelvis height
analysis: Paired differences by seed and by course; do not hide worse lanes or infer policy improvement from a selected subset
